{
  "phoneNote": "The salon styling is coherent, but excessive space around the hero links pushes the small photo collage to the bottom of the first screen.",
  "desktopNote": "The distinctive photo treatment works, but the oversized four-line headline dominates the hero and the later sections feel unnecessarily stretched.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 3,
    "spacing": 2,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 2,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Reduce the desktop hero headline to two or three lines; on phone, tighten the gaps around the links and bring a larger hairstyle photo higher into the first screen.",
    "Replace the oversized opening-hours chart with a compact schedule, remove its duplicate appointment note, and reduce the empty width and padding in the visit-process section.",
    "Consolidate the phone’s closing contact sections into one booking-and-location block, keeping legal details separate without repeating the address, directions, phone and email."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone, contact section and footer: the address and directions block is repeated immediately, followed by another repetition of the phone and email."
  ]
}
